description: Fail over the primary node of each ElastiCache (Redis OSS) replication group, cluster mode disabled, that carries the given tag, using the TestFailover API. Waits until the failover completes and the former primary has recovered as a replica. On a failure or a stop, reports each tagged group's state; it does not undo the failover.

AutomationAssumeRole.description: ARN of the IAM role that Systems Manager Automation assumes to run this document

tagKey.description: Tag key that selects the replication groups to fail over. The SSM role policy's aws:ResourceTag condition on elasticache:TestFailover must name the same key and value.

tagValue.description: Tag value that selects the replication groups to fail over. The SSM role policy's aws:ResourceTag condition on elasticache:TestFailover must name the same key and value.
